import hashlib,importlib.util,inspect,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from sllm_store import v4_convert
p=Path(v4_convert.__file__)
body=inspect.getsource(v4_convert.convert_grouped_store)
assert 'EXPORT_RECEIPTS.json' in body and 'ENGINE_SHUTDOWN.json' in body
native=importlib.util.find_spec('sllm_store._C')
assert native and native.origin.endswith('.so')
assert not ({'torch','vllm','ray'} & set(sys.modules))
print(json.dumps(dict(module=str(p),sha256=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),native_extension=native.origin,torch_imported=False,vllm_imported=False,scope='CPU overlay visibility only; native extension not loaded; no GPU or model')))
